gameConfig.title: Gem Cascade
gameConfig.description: An 8x8 match-3 puzzle with chained cascades, a move limit and a rising score target each level. Illegal swaps snap back and cost nothing.

keyboard: Space or Enter picks up and drops a gem
touch: Tap a gem then tap a neighbour to swap
Or drag a gem toward the neighbour you want it swapped with
mouse: Click a gem then click a neighbour
Or click-drag a gem in the swap direction

mechanics.name: Adjacent swap with rollback
mechanics.description: Only orthogonal neighbours can swap; a swap that produces no match animates back and does not consume a move.
mechanics.implementation: Cells swap in the model first, findMatches() decides, and the inverse tween runs on failure.

mechanics.name: Run detection
mechanics.description: Any horizontal or vertical run of three or more identical gems clears, and overlapping runs clear as one set.
mechanics.implementation: Two linear passes over rows and columns collecting runs into a de-duplicated set keyed by r:c.

mechanics.name: Cascades
mechanics.description: Gems fall into the gaps and new ones drop in from above; any resulting match chains, and each chain step is worth 50% more.
mechanics.implementation: resolveBoard -> collapse -> resolveBoard recursion with a cascade counter driving the multiplier.

mechanics.name: Long-match bonus
mechanics.description: Every gem beyond the third in a single clear is worth an extra 60 points.
mechanics.implementation: extra = max(0, matched - MIN_MATCH) * LONG_MATCH_BONUS applied before the cascade multiplier.

mechanics.name: Move budget and score target
mechanics.description: 25 moves per level against a target that grows 45% each level; hitting the target advances, running out ends the run.
mechanics.implementation: Checked in afterSettle() once the board is stable, never mid-cascade.

mechanics.name: Deadlock reshuffle
mechanics.description: If no legal swap exists the same gems are redealt until the board has a move and no free matches.
mechanics.implementation: hasValidMove() brute-forces every adjacent swap; shuffleBoard() retries up to 50 deals.

mechanics.name: Idle hint
mechanics.description: After 6 seconds without input a legal swap pulses to unstick the player.
mechanics.implementation: findHint() returns the first solvable pair; a looping scale tween marks it until the next input.

mechanics.name: Fair deal
mechanics.description: The starting board never contains a pre-made match and always has at least one legal move.
mechanics.implementation: safeType() bans the type that would complete a run while dealing, then the board is validated before sprites are created.

monetizationHooks: Interstitial ad on every level complete
Interstitial ad every 3rd run on the game-over screen
Rewarded video for +5 moves to continue the current level
320x50 banner slot reserved on the menu
10 coins per level clear, feeding a booster shop (bomb, colour-blast, extra moves)
mobileOptimizations: Phaser.Scale.FIT with CENTER_BOTH; the 448px board centres on any screen
56px cells, comfortably above the 44px touch-target minimum
Both tap-tap and drag-swipe swap gestures with a 45%-of-a-cell drag threshold
Input locked behind a busy flag during animations so fast taps cannot corrupt the board
No physics simulation - tween-driven, so the board is cheap on low-end devices
Loop sleeps and audio suspends when the app is backgrounded
Best score and coins persisted to localStorage
